description: a hand-built run of 04 doing everything #63 asks — one agent turn, no founder turn, a refusal naming the vision's missing approval, no interview question, nothing written. Every check this scenario registers must PASS against it.
notes: 04 has never been run against a model, and every check it registers is tuned
close to a phrasing, so this is the only evidence they pass a correct refusal
rather than merely catching a wrong one.
The refusal therefore carries, deliberately, the three shapes that would
- "Would you like to approve the vision and come back?" against
`forbidApprovalRequest`. A correct refusal sends the founder off to
approve the *vision*; that names approval without offering it, which is
what the vision guard in `flags.approvalRequest` exists for.
- a closing list naming rabbit holes, no-gos and open questions against
`forbidInterviewQuestions`. Telling the founder what the session would
have asked is not asking it.
- a reason that crosses a full stop before it names the missing approval,
`workspaceFiles` is left to the default, which resolves to this scenario's
own seed — the unapproved vision at docs/product/vision.md — and nothing
else, because the graded outcome is that the session wrote nothing.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
I can't start a pitch session from this vision. I read `docs/product/vision.md` — it's there, and it's your clinic-scheduling vision — but it hasn't been approved: there's no `approved_by`/`approved_at` pair on it. A pitch is a bet placed against an approved vision, so I haven't asked you anything and I haven't written anything.

One thing to do: run `/to-vision` on it and approve it there. Would you like to approve the vision and come back? When you do, we'll shape your first bet from it — the problem in her own words, the appetite, the solution sketch, the riskiest assumption and its cheap test, plus rabbit holes, no-gos and open questions.
